variants.headline: Still in view: a new government takes shape
variants.sub: The colony has a newly formed government.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. A new government has been formed in {colony}.

We are unconvinced by {target}. The completion of an arrangement for office does not deserve to be mistaken for political merit; the public is entitled to a more demanding standard.

variants.headline: Still in view: formation is the beginning of governing
variants.sub: Government formation has produced a new administration in {colony}.
variants.body:
This story remains under examination, {months_running} months into our coverage of the original event. The colony has a newly formed government.

We are unconvinced by {target}. The completion of an arrangement for office does not deserve to be mistaken for political merit; the public is entitled to a more demanding standard.

variants.headline: Still in view: new ministry, practical obligations
variants.sub: A new government has been formed in {colony}.
variants.body:
Our attention to this story continues after {months_running} months, with the original report still the starting point. Government formation has produced a new administration in {colony}.

We are unconvinced by {target}. The completion of an arrangement for office does not deserve to be mistaken for political merit; the public is entitled to a more demanding standard.
